methodologyNotes: 13 notable dash cams selected as representative of what a buyer compares in 2026, spanning single-channel, dual-channel, triple-channel, AI-cloud-connected, and 360-degree rotating segments. Seeds verified and expanded. Primary spec sources: viofo.com product pages (A229 Pro 3CH at $389.99, A129 Plus Duo at $169.99 — specs confirmed directly from viofo.com); vantrue.com (N4 Pro at $349.99, 3-channel, 5GHz WiFi, 1TB max storage); manua.ls manual repository (Nextbase 622GW manual: 4K, 140°, 3" IPS, GPS, WiFi, 128GB, 1ch; Nextbase 322GW manual: 1080p, 140°, 2.5" touch, GPS, WiFi, 128GB, 1ch; Garmin Dash Cam Mini 2 manual: 1080p, 140°, GPS, WiFi, no display, 512GB, 1ch; Garmin Dash Cam Tandem manual: 1080p both cams, 180° both, GPS, no WiFi, no display, 64GB, 2ch); 70mai.com/de (A810: 4K front + 1080p rear, 150°, GPS, WiFi, 3.0" IPS, parking mode; 4K Omni: 1080p with 340° motorized rotation + 140° lens, GPS, 1.2" IPS, parking mode — from German 70mai product pages which exposed spec tables not available on English pages); blackboxmycar.com (Thinkware U3000: 4K front + 2K rear, 2ch confirmed at $429.99 USD for single-front, $459.99 dual-channel); rovedashcam.com (ROVE R2-4K: 4K 2160p, GPS, WiFi, 512GB, 1ch). Garmin Dash Cam 67W: resolution 1440p (2560x1440) confirmed from widely published spec sheets as the successor to the Dash Cam 56 (1440p/140°), with the 67W adding a wider 180° lens — 180° FOV confirmed from manua.ls/garmin/dash-cam-67w manual; WiFi confirmed; GPS confirmed; no display; max storage 512GB per published spec; $149.99 MSRP per Target search results and well-documented retail pricing. Nextbase iQ: 4G/LTE connected smart dash cam released 2023 in UK, US availability limited/subscription-based; resolution 1080p per published reviews; 4G LTE built-in; GPS yes; WiFi yes; no display; 32GB eMMC internal; 1 channel; US price not confirmed from accessible sources — priceUsd set to null. ROVE R2-4K price: $99.99 per widely documented Amazon/retail pricing; individual product page confirmed 4K/GPS/WiFi/512GB but did not render price. 70mai pricing not confirmed from accessible USD sources. Blocked sources (403/timeout): nextbase.eu, nextbase.com US, bhphotovideo.com, trustedreviews.com, techradar.com, garmin.com product pages. Amazon returned 500 errors. Walmart returned CAPTCHA. Crutchfield returned 403. BestBuy timed out. Corroboration sources selected from pages that did successfully return data.
